page.overview:
What is Biome?

A biome is a region in a world with distinct geographical features, flora, temperatures, humidities, and sky, water, fog, grass and foliage colors. Biomes separate every generated world into different environments, such as forests, deserts and taigas.

The biome of a location is determined during world generation and by the current environment. If the player completely changes all the blocks in a large area to imitate the terrain of other biomes, the biome will not be affected. This can be only be done with the command, which can change the biome in an area.

Biomes can be located using the command in the chat.

On this page, for convenience of description and reading, the biomes in Overworld are divided into 8 categories, which are not official. While in each category, biomes may be further divided into some sub-categories. Biomes in a sub-categories are placed in one page, such as plains and sunflower plains, and are described as variants on this wiki.

connections.explanation: Crimson Forest's entry mentions Biome — A biome is a region in a world with distinct geographical features, flora, temperatures, humidities, and sky, water, fog, grass and foliage colors.
connections.name: Crimson Forest
connections.short_description: The crimson forest is a forested biome in the Nether.
